question.en: Discuss the significance of the Socio-Economic and Caste Census in targeting welfare schemes in India.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the Socio-Economic and Caste Census in targeting welfare schemes in India.

modelAnswer.en: SECC provides granular data on deprivation, enabling better identification of beneficiaries for schemes like PMAY-G and MGNREGA, moving away from BPL lists to multidimensional poverty assessment.
